item.title: Paul McCartney - Wonderful Christmastime
item.description: video upload by "Official music video for 'Wonderful Christmastime' performed by Paul McCartney." Sequential Circuits Prophet-5 and I believe a Hohner Clavinet D6 in the video. Some say a Yamaha CS80 was used in the recording for the lead pluck sound.

item.title: U-He Bazille: 50 Modular Techno Presets+Patterns Sound Demo
item.description: video upload by Anton Anru "Gravitation Noise is a bank of 50 sequence presets for U-He Bazille.Inspired by the dark techno patterns from previous patch collections on the website for Moog and Make Noise synthesizers, this bank of presets was conceived as an attempt to transfer that experience from analog modular synths into a VST plugin.📦 Get these presets: https://antonanru.sellfy.store/p/
